The profile lives outside the register precisely so a shrink is visible — and a shrink is a compat event (CLAUDE.md rule 10), so it needs a deliberate bump of the profile's own `version` FIELD. Here qpcp.v2.json is qpcp.v1.json with the `locality` class deleted and `version` left at 1: the copy-paste-and-forget shape. Gate 9 would silently stop checking \kloc/\qdim and still report green. Red against the pre-fix source (no such check existed); mutation-proven by relaxing the comparison to `>=`, which drops the finding and passes this fixture. The filename's v2 is the reference key only — the `version` field is the counter the rule reads, so renaming the file can never launder a shrink.
